name: Telegram Order Status Assistant
description: Lets customers request an order update through Telegram after verifying a limited order reference and returns only the minimum status information needed.

steps.description: Ask the customer for an order reference and one approved verification field.
Compare the submitted values with the order source using a rate-limited lookup.
Return a minimal order status without exposing addresses, payment details, or unrelated records.
Escalate repeated verification failures to support without revealing which value was incorrect.

privacy.notes: Do not log verification fields in plain text, limit repeated attempts, and return only the status fields required by the customer.

testing: Use a valid test order and confirm only the approved status fields are returned.
Use an invalid verification field and confirm no order information is revealed.
Repeat failed attempts and confirm rate limiting or human escalation is triggered.
